title: Black Friday on a card: the minimum due trap 🛍️
description:
What does a $1,500 Black Friday haul really cost if you only pay the minimum?
An assumed card rate and minimum due, computed month by month: how long it takes and the interest you pay. No card or bank named. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
